sentences.text: The present interlocutory application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner for amendment in paragraph no. 1 as well as in the prayer portion of the writ petition seeking payment of compensation of Rs.34,20,000/- along with statutory interest and solatium as per the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, as according to the petitioner, the market value of the land has been fixed @ Rs.1,42,500/- per decimal.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the proposed amendment has been detailed in page nos. 4 and 5 of the present interlocutory application.

3. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and for the reasons stated in the present interlocutory application, the petitioner is permitted to add the prayer as proposed in page nos. 4 and 5 of the present interlocutory application.
The supporting statement made in the supplementary affidavit dated 30.08.2024 shall be treated as part of the writ petition.

4. The present interlocutory application stands disposed of.
5. Let necessary insertion in the relevant part of the writ petition be made by learned counsel for the petitioner in course of the day.
6.
Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and is allowed four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
